data.body: PROGRESS: GHA canary workflow (reconcile-bridge-canary.yml) implemented using DSO ticket system pattern (follows inbound-bridge.yml). Committed on session branch worktree-20260522-122311 (876e85987d). Canary: hourly cron + workflow_dispatch, mounts tickets branch as worktree, creates/comments/closes DSO bug ticket tagged heartbeat-alert. Push retry loop follows inbound-bridge.yml 5-retry exponential-backoff rebase pattern. PENDING: workflow must reach main before workflow_dispatch test can fire. Final closure check (timestamped test alert in this ticket) will complete after sprint merge-to-main.
